description: This file is a shell script defining tests for Git's note-adding and note-adding behaviors with various options related to stripspace, multiple message and file inputs, and object referencing. It includes test setup, execution, and comparison steps for different command-line argument combinations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion for cleanup or final checks.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output of commands or files for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if output contains specific text or patterns.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Creates a Git object from given data and outputs its hash.

methods.name: git notes add
methods.description: Adds notes to a Git object, supporting multiple options and inputs.

methods.name: git notes show
methods.description: Displays notes associated with a Git object.

methods.name: git notes remove
methods.description: Removes notes from a Git object.

methods.name: git notes append
methods.description: Appends additional notes to existing notes.

methods.name: git notes edit
methods.description: Edits existing notes for a Git object.
